registerPolicy: Per realization, not a family-wide 14-semitone rule. The higher example uses 14; the inside example uses 2 for the same added component.
recognitionPolicy: Pitch-class identity and exact-voicing matching are separate tasks. Do not ban pitch-class matches merely to enforce an add9/add2 label.
inversionPolicy: No automatic four-position generation; no assertion that added-note chords lack inversions.
repositoryAdapter: Reuse real types and family adapter; never parallel-maintain another runtime dictionary or import this entire package on the client.
